CENTERING REPORT

Grader estimates

LIVE

Indicative centering-only estimates based on your front and back measurements. Enabled graders are taken from Settings.

Adjust your card borders to see centering estimates.

These are not official grades. Surface, corners, edges and each company's current grading standards can change the final result.

Centering measurements

Manual mode: enter each border as a percentage out of 100. Left + right must equal 100, and top + bottom must equal 100. Example: L45 / R55 and T48 / B52.

Front centering

Front centering score100 / 100

Back centering

Back centering score100 / 100
Centering score is a proportionality indicator, not a professional grade. Company tolerances differ and grading also depends on corners, edges and surface.

AI pre-grade

Capture or choose clear front and back photos here. Review the visible condition indicators below, then calculate a preliminary point score out of 10.

Back photo

Camera scanner

Place the full card inside the guide. Keep the camera parallel to the card and use even lighting.

Assessment areas follow the broad principles used by PSA, Beckett (BGS), ACE, CGC and TAG: centering, corners, edges and surface. Each company applies its own criteria, weighting and grading scale. BGS 10 is shown as the highest BGS grade; this shared score is an estimate, not an official company grade.

Add both card photos, review the condition selections and calculate your score.

Prototype limitation: this version does not yet run a trained vision AI model. The camera captures the photos, but the condition ratings are selected by you. Automatic scratch, dent, whitening and corner detection requires a connected vision model and validation on real graded cards.

Live sold data: eBay's official Marketplace Insights API can return sold items and sale dates for up to 90 days, but it is a limited-release API requiring eBay approval. This prototype opens the matching eBay sold search; it does not yet import sold prices automatically.
